updates.title: Updates
updates.engine.recipe: Installed on {0}. The dependencies the application requires for this engine have changed: it will be reinstalled.
updates.model.changed: {0} file(s) changed on Hugging Face, ≈ {1} to download.
updates.note: Nothing updates without your click. An engine is replaced as a whole; for a model, only the changed files are downloaded. A model loaded in memory has to be unloaded first.
updates.latest.warning: Version {0} has not been tested with the application: it may break models that work today.
updates.latest.regression: Warning, version {0} falls in a known regression range: {1} (source: {2}).
updates.latest.confirm.title: Install an untested version?
updates.latest.confirm.message: “{0}” will be replaced by version {1}, which the application has not tested. {2} You can go back to the tested version afterwards.
updates.latest.confirm.messageRegression: “{0}” will be replaced by version {1}, which the application has not tested. {2} You can still choose it; you can go back to the tested version afterwards.
updates.rollback.action: Go back to the tested version ({0})
updates.rollback.note: The installed version is newer than the one the application has tested.
updates.advice.stale: This advice is about another version than the one offered today: run the analysis again.
updates.advice.auto.tip: After each check, analyses the risks of the updates with the local model (this loads a model into memory). Off by default.
updates.advice.saved.title: Latest saved advice
updates.advice.saved.hint: Saved on this machine, shown without a network; they will be attached to the updates as soon as the check can read the versions.
updates.advice.invite.title: Analyse the risks of updates (local AI)
updates.advice.invite.body: A small local chat model reads the release notes and public discussions and reports known problems (regressions, crashes). Nothing you write or generate is sent. The advice is informative: it never blocks an update.
updates.advice.invite.partsPresent: engine ≈ {0} MB; model “{2}” already on this machine
updates.advice.confirm.title: Update discouraged by the analysis
updates.advice.confirm.message: The automatic analysis found problems: {0}. It is advice to check, not a ban. Install anyway?
